meta.title: Chronell — Manage your time, not your inbox
meta.description: Chronell 1.0.0: Custom views with layout wizard, mail & calendar workspace — desktop work hub for Windows 11 with Microsoft 365 and Google.

hero.positioning: Chronell is not an email client. It's a system to manage your time.
hero.subline: Microsoft 365 and Google in one desktop workspace — custom views from mail, calendar, and tasks, floating panels, and a refined mail and calendar workspace. Built for Windows 11.

caption.mail: Triage instead of an endless inbox — select multiple messages, turn them into to-dos or snooze them without opening every thread.
caption.calendar: Events, mail to-dos, and cloud tasks in one week view — with a timeline and mail context in the same screen.
caption.tasks: Microsoft To Do and Google Tasks beside mail and calendar — due dates, recurrence, and planned blocks in one window.
caption.notes: Core notes on mail and events — Markdown with preview and direct links into the graph.
caption.contacts: Contacts with linked mail and tasks — people as nodes in your work network, not just an address book.
caption.connections: Your unique work network: mail, events, tasks, and notes as a graph — with AI suggestions you confirm.

quote.text: Your inbox is not a workplace.

method.title: A system to turn time into progress
method.idea: Most people manage emails. With Chronell, you manage your time.
method.oneliner: The Chronell Method turns your inbox into a timeline.
method.builtIn: The method isn't theory — it's built into the app you use every day.

capture.title: Capture
capture.subtitle: Everything in one place
capture.b1: Email, tasks, notes and events belong together — not in separate apps.
capture.b2: No tab chaos. No context switching.
capture.app: Ten modules including Connections, Bookings, M365 + Google, global search.

decide.title: Decide
decide.subtitle: Turn input into action
decide.b1: Every input becomes a decision: do it, plan it, delay it, or archive it.
decide.b2: Your inbox is a decision point — not a warehouse.
decide.app: Mail to-dos, snooze, connections in the graph, AI suggestions you confirm.

plan.title: Plan
plan.subtitle: Time is the real resource
plan.b1: Tasks are meaningless without time — everything gets time, context, priority.
plan.b2: One calendar for appointments, mail tasks, cloud tasks and notes.
plan.app: Unified calendar, Book with me, Microsoft Bookings, timeline view.

execute.title: Execute
execute.subtitle: Work in blocks, not chaos
execute.b1: Work happens in focused time blocks — not between emails.
execute.b2: Your system becomes plannable, focused, controllable.
execute.app: All Work module with list, kanban, and workflow threads.

compare.title: Outlook shows messages. Chronell shows what matters.

claims.c1: Outlook shows you messages. Chronell shows you what matters.
claims.c3: Emails are input. Time is what matters.
claims.c4: See relationships in a graph — not across ten tabs.

table.focusC: Workflow: to-dos, snooze, rules, connections, one desktop
table.weightT: Full Office web or heavy suites
table.bookingsC: Business Bookings in-app; Book with me in calendar
table.bookingsT: Often Outlook web only or separate tabs
table.connectionsC: Graph across mail, notes, tasks, contacts — AI suggests, you confirm
table.connectionsT: Separate apps, manual tracking of context
table.cloudSyncC: Optional: notes, connections, rules — mail stays with M365/Google

compare.disclaimer: Chronell is not a replacement for every enterprise Outlook or Exchange admin scenario. Strengths: workflow, local data, AI connections, multi-provider, Fluent UI for power users.

detailed.r4chronell: Fluent 2 / Windows 11: Mica, acrylic, design presets (Midnight, Nord, …)
detailed.r5chronell: Intentionally not — focus on M365 and Google
detailed.r6typical: Notes in OneNote, mail in Outlook — separate
detailed.r6chronell: Connection graph + AI scan (Gemini, OpenAI, local Ollama)
detailed.r7typical: Set up again or full account sync
detailed.r7chronell: Cloud sync for profile (rules, notes, connections) — mail separate

updates.title: What shipped in recent updates
updates.lead: From the new Fluent look to the connection graph and profile sync — Chronell moves fast without putting your mail in the cloud.

v0923.title: ICS import, meta folders & module polish
v0923.b1: Calendar: import .ics files via drag & drop or dialog into Microsoft 365 and Google calendars — one or many events at once
v0923.b2: Meta folders: visual rule editor with expression builder instead of text only — understand and maintain rules faster
v0923.b3: Settings: dedicated panels for calendar, tasks, and notes; unified date picker across events, tasks, and notes

v0922.title: Branding, zoom & group calendars
v0922.b1: New Chronell icon and logo in the app, taskbar, and on chronell.app — consistent look everywhere
v0922.b2: UI zoom: Ctrl+Shift+Plus/Minus/0 works reliably on German keyboards too (routed via the main process)
v0922.b3: Microsoft 365 group calendars: transitive membership with fallback to direct groups; clearer hints when permissions are missing
v0922.b4: Composer: group recipient search via advanced Graph query; homepage with interactive module demo and refined mockups

v0921.title: Mail bulk, events & backup

v0921.b3: Settings: auto backup to a folder you choose, contents preview before import; to-do thread cache and readable link colors in editor and reading preview
v0921.b4: More reliable sign-in (MSAL cache, token lock); installer download via GitHub Releases

v0920.title: Composer, editor & cloud attachments
v0920.b1: New composer: send-as with alias and shared mailbox, message options, text snippets, light/dark editor theme
v0920.b2: OneDrive and SharePoint: files as cloud attachment or sharing link in the message body — explorer with favorites and link settings
v0920.b3: Refined TipTap editor; reading preview zoom (Ctrl+wheel); shortcut overview and UI zoom in settings
v0920.b4: Privacy page on the website; many bug fixes in mail, sync, graph, and home compose tile

v0919.title: Connections & calendar polish
v0919.b1: Note preview in the connection graph, improved object preview, and node context menu

highlights.title: Four pillars of the desktop work hub
highlights.lead: With version 1.0.0, Chronell becomes a complete work hub: a dedicated notes module, refined mail and calendar workspaces, and visible connections in the graph — locally on Windows 11.

compose.title: Notes
compose.desc: Notes module with sections, TipTap editor, ink, embeds, and links to mail, events, and contacts.
compose.b1: Structure: sections, pages, templates, and quick capture from the system tray
compose.b2: Editor: formatting, tables, wiki links, cloud tasks, and many embeds
compose.b3: Connected: entity links and calendar view for scheduled note pages

connections.title: Mail
connections.desc: Multi-account mail for Microsoft 365 and Google — with EWS, context sidebar, and an improved composer.
connections.b1: EWS as an additional transport for Microsoft mail — alongside Graph
connections.b2: Context sidebar: contact, history, and calendar right in the reading pane
connections.b3: Index attachments locally — faster search without cloud upload

ai.title: Calendar
ai.desc: Events, mail to-dos, cloud tasks, and Bookings in one shell — with a redesigned dialog and ICS import.
ai.b1: Redesigned event dialog — unified date picker and recurrence
ai.b2: Microsoft Bookings and ICS import via drag & drop
ai.b3: Saved layout, categories, and preview in the right column

cloudSync.title: Connections & views
cloudSync.desc: Make relationships visible and compose workspaces freely — custom tabs, floating panels, profile sync.
cloudSync.b1: Connection graph across mail, notes, tasks, events, and contacts
cloudSync.b2: Custom views: layout wizard, zones, detachable panels
cloudSync.b3: Profile sync: take views and settings to your second PC

showcase.title: One window — connections instead of silos
showcase.lead: Outlook, Apple Mail, or separate apps each show only a slice. Chronell connects mail, calendar, tasks, notes, and contacts — visible in the graph, without putting your data in someone else's cloud.

calendar.vs: Instead of calendar tab + mail tab + to-do app
calendar.title: One calendar for events, mail to-dos, and cloud tasks
calendar.desc: Chronell puts M365 and Google calendars, open mail to-dos, and Microsoft To Do / Google Tasks in one week view — with a timeline column and optional mail preview beside it.
calendar.b1: Timeline: Overdue, today, and later in one column — not just colored blocks in the grid.
calendar.b2: Context: Select an event and see the related mail or note in the right column.
calendar.b3: Book with me & recurrence: Booking links and series without switching to Outlook on the web.

tasks.vs: Instead of To Do as a separate Microsoft add-in
tasks.title: Tasks where you already work
tasks.desc: Microsoft To Do and Google Tasks live in Chronell next to mail and calendar — with due buckets and a week grid for planned blocks.
tasks.b1: One window: Create a task from mail, schedule it on the calendar, triage it in Work.
tasks.b2: Recurrence: Repeating cloud tasks (native on M365, local for Google) — not just one-off flags.
tasks.b3: No context loss: Detail panel and global search across tasks, mail, and events.

notes.vs: Instead of notes in OneNote and mail in Outlook
notes.title: Core notes that participate
notes.desc: Notes attach to mail, events, or stand alone — with Markdown, sections, and entity links into the connection graph.
notes.b1: Linked: Connect from the reading pane or an event — the graph shows the relationship.
notes.b2: Editor: Markdown with live preview, attachments, and optional show on calendar.
notes.b3: Cloud sync: Profile including notes on a second PC — mail content stays with providers.

contacts.vs: Instead of an address book without work context
contacts.title: People with history, not just fields
contacts.desc: Contacts from Microsoft 365 and Google — cached locally, fast to search, linked to mail, events, and notes.
contacts.b1: One search index: Person, mail, note, and event via Ctrl+K — offline from SQLite.
contacts.b2: Linked objects: See at a glance which mail and tasks belong to a contact.
contacts.b3: Multi-account: Several accounts, one people view — no profile switching in the browser.

connections.vs: Outlook, Gmail, and others don't have this
connections.title: Connections — your work network visible
connections.desc: The graph shows mail, events, tasks, notes, and contacts as nodes. Islands group related work; AI suggests links — you confirm each one.
connections.b1: No silos: Project mail, workshop event, and note as a connected island — not hunting across five apps.
connections.b2: AI with opt-in: Scan for missing links; text excerpts only when you allow it.
connections.b3: Everywhere: Mini-graph in the reading pane, preview dock, and dedicated module — layout savable.

limits.title: What Chronell is not
limits.p1: Chronell isn't a full Outlook replacement for enterprise. Complex Exchange admin policies, mailbox delegation, or compliance archival workflows are out of scope — Outlook does that.
limits.p2: Cloud sync is profile sync, not a mail mirror: mailboxes stay with providers. AI suggestions don't replace thinking — they speed up linking.
limits.p3: Chronell is a command center for people who juggle multiple accounts and want visible links between mail, tasks, and notes.

customViews.title: Custom views
customViews.desc: Your own tabs with a layout wizard: combine mail, calendar, timeline, dashboard tiles, and preview — detach panels and dock them back.

design.title: Fluent design
design.desc: Fluent 2 tokens app-wide: Mica, shell bars, acrylic overlays, dashboard panels, and selectable dark/light presets.

connections.title: Connections
connections.desc: Interactive graph with preview dock, context mini-graph, path highlight — from mail to notes to contacts.

ai.title: AI connections
ai.desc: Suggestions and scans with Gemini, OpenAI, or Ollama — embeddings, snippet opt-in, audit log in settings.

cloudSync.title: Cloud sync
cloudSync.desc: Profile via Supabase on multiple devices — auto-sync, conflict resolution, note attachments. Mail stays local / with M365/Google.

bookings.title: Microsoft Bookings
bookings.desc: Booking pages, services, and appointments for your team — in the app, no Outlook web tab.

triage.title: Mail & composer
triage.desc: Triage with to-dos, snooze, and quick steps — plus new composer (TipTap), OneDrive/SharePoint attachments, reading preview zoom, and pop-out window.

tasks.title: Tasks (M365 & Google)
tasks.desc: Microsoft To Do and Google Tasks in one window — lists, due dates, tied to mail and calendar.

calendar.title: Unified calendar
calendar.desc: M365 and Google calendars, mail to-dos, and scheduled notes — with timeline and Book with me.

work.title: All Work
work.desc: Mail to-dos and cloud tasks in one list or kanban — workflow threads with AI connection check.

notes.title: Core notes
notes.desc: Notes on mail, events, and standalone pages — bidirectionally linked in the connection graph.

rules.title: Visual rules
rules.desc: Conditions and actions with dry-run — automation without code.

people.title: People
people.desc: Contacts from M365 and Google, cached locally and fast to search.

home.title: Home dashboard
home.desc: Customizable tiles for your day — overview at a glance.

chat.title: Teams chat
chat.desc: Microsoft Teams next to mail and calendar — no app switching.

accounts.title: Accounts & search
accounts.desc: Every mailbox and meta-folder in one window — global search with local full-text index.

offline.title: Offline reading
offline.desc: Your local cache stays usable — even without a connection.

privacy.title: Local by design
privacy.desc: SQLite on your device — OAuth to Microsoft and Google only; AI keys in secure store.

screenshots.title: See Chronell in action
screenshots.lead: Fluent UI, mail triage, connection graph, and dashboard — how Chronell looks on your desktop.

trust.title: Your data stays with you
trust.oauth: Sign in via official Microsoft and Google OAuth flows
trust.local: Mail and metadata in local SQLite — search via FTS5
trust.platform: Windows 11 desktop (Electron) — Microsoft 365 and Google only, no IMAP
trust.cloudSync: Cloud sync is profile-only (notes, connections, rules) — no mail content, no OAuth tokens in the cloud

footer.tagline: Chronell is not a tool. It's your command center — with visible links between mail, tasks, and time.
footer.author: Kurt Soeser

cta.title: Ready for the new Chronell?
cta.body: Download version 1.0.0 for Windows 11 — custom views with layout wizard, floating panels, refined mail and calendar workspace, and optional cloud sync. Updates replace your version without losing data.
